identities: original approved operator Google identity for maintenance only
original approved ordinary invited-owner Google identity for newproject/twoSessions/threeTurns
operatorFreshChecks: server actual principal/authVersion binds original maintenance request/ACK
ordinaryFreshChecks: same original approved ordinary identity, no other accounts or old project restore
applicationSessions.switchMethod: normal app sign-out/Google sign-in flow only as necessary, no cookie/session export or direct auth DB write

boundedHumanWindow: new execution authorization<=4h and<=October20 ceiling; existing persistent same-scope OAuth or Google session does not expire/revoke merely because this window ends

cloudflare.alternativeExistingLocalPath: if the preselected supported execution path uses local OAuth, only necessary normal token retrieval/refresh of existing same-user exact six scopes; no new login/consent/scopes, no replay of an unknown authentication outcome
cloudflare.primarySupportedConnector: existing Personal Cloudflare connection to this same account; no new app/connector/key permission
cloudflare.sourceContract: reuse previous pinned normal-token/CI/no-login/no-extra-scope/no-disk-logs behavior; no new auth runner authored
cloudflare.unknownOrPermissionFailure: stop original identity; no automatic connector/credential/login/provider fallback after unknown
